chunks.text: Our first step in considering data is to think about how it's aggregated.

chunks.title: How data is aggregated
chunks.text: In other words, imagine that many, many trades are happening on different

chunks.title: How data is aggregated
chunks.text: exchanges.

chunks.title: How data is aggregated
chunks.text: How is all the data combined and how is it reported back to us so

chunks.title: How data is aggregated
chunks.text: that we can analyze it and use it?

chunks.title: How data is aggregated
chunks.text: The finest resolution of data is called a tick.

chunks.title: How data is aggregated
chunks.text: A tick represents a successful buy, sell match or a successful transaction.

chunks.title: How data is aggregated
chunks.text: So let's suppose that this time there was a successful transaction,

chunks.title: How data is aggregated
chunks.text: $100 was the price and $200 was the volume.

chunks.title: How data is aggregated
chunks.text: So we record that here with a single point.

chunks.title: How data is aggregated
chunks.text: A little bit later there was another transaction, 9905, 100 shares.

chunks.title: How data is aggregated
chunks.text: Now something to keep in mind is each of these transactions happens at no specific

chunks.title: How data is aggregated
chunks.text: time.

chunks.title: How data is aggregated
chunks.text: It happens only when the buy and sell are matched.

chunks.title: How data is aggregated
chunks.text: So there's no guarantee that there's going to be a trade in any particular

chunks.title: How data is aggregated
chunks.text: minute or any particular hour.

chunks.title: How data is aggregated
chunks.text: It just happens when it happens.

chunks.title: How data is aggregated
chunks.text: Each exchange provides its own data feed regarding these transactions.

chunks.title: How data is aggregated
chunks.text: So you can subscribe to these feeds and see at each tick when a transaction happens

chunks.title: How data is aggregated
chunks.text: on any particular exchange.

chunks.title: How data is aggregated
chunks.text: So I've added some red dots here that represent transactions that might be

chunks.title: How data is aggregated
chunks.text: happening on another exchange.

chunks.title: How data is aggregated
chunks.text: Note that the prices are a little bit different.

chunks.title: How data is aggregated
chunks.text: The volumes of course might be different.

chunks.title: How data is aggregated
chunks.text: All of this is happening simultaneously and the prices of different exchanges

chunks.title: How data is aggregated
chunks.text: aren't guaranteed to be exactly the same.

chunks.title: How data is aggregated
chunks.text: Now for highly liquid stocks, there may be hundreds or thousands or hundreds of

chunks.title: How data is aggregated
chunks.text: thousands of transactions like these every second.

chunks.title: How data is aggregated
chunks.text: So collecting and using all these ticks for all the exchanges over a long period of

chunks.title: How data is aggregated
chunks.text: time would result in a lot, a lot of data and it becomes very complex.

chunks.title: How data is aggregated
chunks.text: Tick data is usually consolidated into minute by minute or hour by hour chunks.

chunks.title: How data is aggregated
chunks.text: So I've drawn some boundaries here, let's suppose those are on minute boundaries.

chunks.title: How data is aggregated
chunks.text: And we collect all the data together within each minute and

chunks.title: How data is aggregated
chunks.text: represent it as open, high, low, close, and volume.

chunks.title: How data is aggregated
chunks.text: So the open is the first transaction within the time period.

chunks.title: How data is aggregated
chunks.text: So it came in here, we had a transaction at 100.

chunks.title: How data is aggregated
chunks.text: So our open value here is 100 within this time period.

chunks.title: How data is aggregated
chunks.text: High, well you look at the entire time period and

chunks.title: How data is aggregated
chunks.text: see what was the highest price.

chunks.title: How data is aggregated
chunks.text: Highest price here was also 100.

chunks.title: How data is aggregated
chunks.text: Low was 9905.

chunks.title: How data is aggregated
chunks.text: Close is the last transaction, and that was 9550.

chunks.title: How data is aggregated
chunks.text: And volume is just the total volume during that time period.

chunks.title: How data is aggregated
chunks.text: So it's 200 plus 100 plus 300, so 600 shares.

chunks.title: How data is aggregated
chunks.text: So for this minute of time we've consolidated all that information into open,

chunks.title: How data is aggregated
chunks.text: high, low, close, and volume.

chunks.title: How data is aggregated
chunks.text: Similarly, we go to the next minute and consolidate it in the same way.

chunks.title: How data is aggregated

chunks.title: How data is aggregated
chunks.text: high was 99.95, and our volume was 300.

chunks.title: How data is aggregated
chunks.text: And we would continue throughout the day to consolidate the data at each minute like

chunks.text: this.

chunks.title: How data is aggregated
chunks.text: And depending on your data feed, this might be the result, say,

chunks.title: How data is aggregated
